scope: Local Golden Plains Horse riding prototype v1
method: Unchanged imported horse and its approved idle/walk/trot/gallop clips; profile-driven seated rider, existing upper-body action layer, borrowed imported pony saddle and live leather straps.

authoring.saddleSourceSelection: All triangle vertices have >95% ownership by the source saddle subtree. Independently checked: selected triangles equal all 67 complete saddle components; body boundary triangles excluded.
authoring.saddleAttributes: Existing positions fitted once; original UVs/material retained, normals/tangents transformed for the static fit. No per-gait blanket stretching.
authoring.gaitTiming: Existing source durations retained: Walk 1.12s, Jog 0.66s, Gallop 0.56s. Playback adapts to visual scale and travel speed; the reviewed half-rate mounted trot preference is retained.
authoring.sourceFps: No motion rebake or retiming export performed; existing source clips retained.

validation.headlessNote: Existing pony baseline/cape tests emit dummy-renderer resource cleanup warnings on exit; numerical checks pass. The cape test report paths were redirected in an ignored test copy.

gates.sourceAuthoring: Current source assets and animation mappings unchanged; saddle source subset independently counted.
gates.exportFidelity: Not applicable: runtime attachment/profile prototype; no Blender export or animated GLB replacement.
gates.godotIntegration: Actual player actor, horse model, mount routing, saddle, reins, cape, bow/spell recovery, mount switching and death interruption passed.
gates.visualReview: Reviewed side, front-quarter and rear game-camera views; sampled gait cycles, aiming/release, spell and recovery frames.
gates.explicitUserApproval: Pending user review of horse prototype v1

reviewControls: Space pauses/resumes; R restarts the sequence.
limitations: Local review only. Server ownership, horse selection and live balance are not enabled.
Visual review covers two representative rider bodies; other race/equipment combinations remain to be checked.
Saddle is fitted from the existing imported pony tack for the prototype.
